pages.title: Starlight Imbuing
pages.content:
starlight imbuing - aka stardust imbuing is a mechanic that buffs an item's damage and increases every apply but there's a catch— every apply increases the cost by 10 stardust
which isn't good if you have basically no stardust
luckily— daily quests and weekly quests award stardust
so it shouldn't be too hard to max it out
which is level 10 btw
imbuing can only level up damage (artifact damage if imbuing artifacts)
imbuing also applies certain effects to certain artifacts:
firework arrow (mcdii): level 10 = 5 fireworks per shot
lightning rod (mcdii): 10 = 3 strikes
updraft tome: each level widens and strengthens the lift
ghost cloak: each level adds half a second of ghost mode

pages.title: Progression Progress
pages.content:
progression progress is the amount of % you have for badges
there are 70 badges in the game excluding my own amethyst badges which is 63
you gain progression by unlocking badges
completing all normal badges unlocks the first progression star
completing all badges gives the secret progression star
completing all amethyst badges gives the amethyst star

pages.title: hardcoding in items
pages.content:
this can be a *bit* hard if your new to adding stuff to the project
so heres a little tutorial on what each number/text is
first off
the 'stormlander' thing
THAT is the *item* name
replace the text inside with your own item name
second
the number following that is the **damage** number
set it to anything you want, but be aware.. the higher it is the more it costs to buy
third, the 'Epic'
thats the rarity. set it to ANYTHING you want. well, not *anything*
theres a set catalog of rarities, which you can hardcode. well, not hardcoding but just adding one
anyways, the catalog for it is..
common
rare
epic
mythical
divine
magma
electric
unique
void
void+
seasonal
forgotten
shadow
dark
terror
special
gravity
flamed
pixel
artifact
dominance
frozen
see [rarities](section:Rarities) for all of them if you dont wanna look off of this
also, the rarity name IS case-sensitive
so make sure you uppercase it
4th is the max power level
set it to anything but still be aware cost of the item skyrockets
you can also set it to infinity but that doesnt make it do damage its just for flair
5th is protection
apply it to ONLY armor items
6th is artifact damage
set it to anything.. you get it
7th is the seasonal true/false
you can only put true/false or else
i **WILL** find you
anyways
8th is the seasonal level
goes up to 3
anything above im doxing you
9th is the quote
thanks for reading

im sending nukes to your house
dont forget to put the item image or youll have 0 image and youll be made fun of
